title: FasciaCompartment / FasciaStructure
description: Deep fascial sheets, intermuscular septa, retinacula and aponeuroses, and the osteofascial compartments they bound. Modeled per Stecco's fascial-continuity framework: every entry records what it physically attaches to (bone via Sharpey's fibers, adjacent fascia, epimysium of enclosed muscles) so the rig can treat fascia as a connective mesh riding between its attachment anchors rather than a free-floating shell.

bony_attachments.description: Enthesis-like fixation points (Sharpey's fibers) binding this fascial structure rigidly to a bone's local frame — these become rig anchors identical in kind to tendon entheses.

adjacent_fascia.description: ids of continuous/blending neighboring fascial structures

compartment_contents.description: muscle/nerve/vessel ids enclosed, if this entry defines an osteofascial compartment
